title: Block and unblock
summary: Blocks a person (Matrix ignore): their messages, chat requests and invites stop showing on all the person's devices. A blocked DM stays, with the composer off and a bar to unblock (ADR 0141). Also the list of blocked people in privacy settings.

target.description: The user ID in the confirm.

targetName.description: Its display name, for the title.

blocked.description: Client.ignoredUsers, kept current with the ignored-users listener. Rows show name and @, never the Matrix ID.

confirmBlock.effect: Client.ignoreUser. In an open DM the composer turns off and the unblock bar shows.

unblock.effect: Client.unignoreUser, from the bar, the profile or the blocked list.

observe.effect: Client.subscribeToIgnoredUsers while the list or a chat with a blocked person is open.

notes: The blocked person gets no notice. Matrix ignore lives in the account data, so it follows the account to every device.
The SDK drops the ignored person's events from timelines and the room list after the next sync; the DM row itself stays (ADR 0141).
Blocking does not report. The block confirm can offer report-person as a second step.
